name: roku-mcp
description: Unofficial. Roku device automation for Claude Code on LAN dev devices and Roku Cloud Emulator (RCE) Cloud Devices: sideload deploy, ECP remote control, screenshots, debug console, runtime SceneGraph UI editing, BrightScript and Perfetto profiling, and stream failure diagnosis. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Roku, Inc.

ROKU_DEVICE_HOST.title: Roku device host
ROKU_DEVICE_HOST.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku dev device. Leave empty to use SSDP discovery.

ROKU_DEVICE_PASSWORD.title: Roku developer password
ROKU_DEVICE_PASSWORD.description: Developer mode password set on the Roku device.

ROKU_RCE_TOKEN.title: Roku Cloud Emulator token
ROKU_RCE_TOKEN.description: Optional. RCE personal access token; required only to use Roku Cloud Emulator Cloud Devices. RCE Runs cost $0.20 per hour.

ROKU_RCE_DEVICE.title: Default RCE Cloud Device
ROKU_RCE_DEVICE.description: Optional. Default Cloud Device id or exact name. When set, device tools target it unless a host is passed.

ROKU_RCE_PASSWORD.title: RCE Cloud Device developer password
ROKU_RCE_PASSWORD.description: Optional. Developer password of the Cloud Device (used for deploy, delete and screenshot).
